filter: rounded raw count >= 10 in at least 3 of 6 samples
design: ~ condition; 3 independent biological replicates per group; unpaired
contrast: IL17A-stimulated ADSC CM versus unstimulated ADSC CM, RNA from HFF-1
input_method: counts-only analysis requested by user; raw Salmon gene counts rounded for DESeq2 integer input; no gene effective-length offset
multiple_testing: BH across all estimable P-values after count filtering; default Cook outlier handling
LFC: unshrunken maximum-likelihood log2FC; Wald tests H0: log2FC=0; abs log2FC threshold is a post-test effect-size filter
pending: batch unknown; gene effective-length changes and Salmon inferential uncertainty are not modeled; result depends on approximate stability of gene effective lengths
